trust_decision.summary: Design-module id lists (brands / products) are assumed to be integer ids and are string-interpolated into ORDER BY raw SQL (FIELD(...) on MySQL, CASE WHEN ... on other drivers) in the repository layer; the fix casts them to positive ints both at save time (DesignService) and inside the repos.

landing_point.why: Advisory names the admin Design Builder endpoint; update() passes the JSON body through DesignService::handleRequestModules and stores it as design_setting.

fix_sites.module_kind: service (save-time normaliser for stored design JSON)

fix_sites.entry_point: GET / shop home render (beike/Shop/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:63 -> DesignService.php:147); POST admin design/builder/preview (admin.php:121); GET admin brands/names (admin.php:53 -> BrandController.php:133-134 -> BrandRepo.php:159)

GET / shop home render and POST design/builder/preview via DesignService.php:240,274 -> ProductRepo::getProductsByIds (ProductRepo.php:76); also shop/adminapi product relations (beike/Shop/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php:33)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: beike/Repositories/BrandRepo.php:174-191 reached directly by GET admin brands/names (beike/Admin/Http/Controllers/BrandController.php:131-134, explode of ?ids=); also PUT settings/values (beike/Admin/Routes/admin.php:276 -> beike/Admin/Services/SettingService.php:34-35) stores arbitrary keys incl. design_setting, bypassing the save-time sanitiser in DesignService

O3_reason_to_dismiss: brands/names and settings/values are not the Design Builder endpoint named in the report; a solver who sanitises in DesignService::handleRequestModules (save time) can argue the repo helpers only ever receive ids the builder already cleaned.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Display order must follow the admin-chosen id order (FIELD / CASE ordering), ids arrive as numeric strings from explode(',') or JSON, and the same builder serves the non-MySQL CASE branch; an over-broad fix that rejects string ids, drops the ordering, or empties whole modules on one bad id breaks the home page and the editor name lookups.

O6_input_shapes: array of numeric strings / mixed strings, intval-cast and non-positive dropped (fix.diff:13-15, fix.diff:29-31)
scalar instead of array, cast via (array) in repos (fix.diff:13, fix.diff:29) and replaced by [] in DesignService (fix.diff:76-78)
MySQL FIELD branch and non-MySQL CASE WHEN branch (beike/Repositories/BrandRepo.php:182-191)

O7_producer.where: stored design JSON is reloaded via system_setting('base.design_setting') at beike/Shop/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:28 and passed to DesignService::handleModuleContent at beike/Shop/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:63; it can also be written by beike/Admin/Services/SettingService.php:34-35 without passing DesignService::handleRequestModules

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET admin products/names?product_ids= -> ProductRepo::getNames -> getListByProductIds interpolates the exploded ids into orderByRaw FIELD(...) with no int cast; the fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Name-lookup helper for the editor UI (called from design module blade views), not the Design Builder save/render path; behind products_index permission; whereIn() is parameter-bound so it looks safe at a glance.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: beike/Admin/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php:208-211 -> beike/Repositories/ProductRepo.php:411,434; same file as a fixed site but a different function ~300 lines away

O8_uncovered_routes.route: design module codes 'category', 'latest' and 'tab_product' reach ProductRepo::getProductsByIds without the save-time sanitiser (which only handles 'brand' and 'product'); covered only by the repo-level cast
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Covered at the pinned fix by ProductRepo.php:129 change; only uncovered if a solver fixes only at save time.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: page module getPagesByIds could plausibly gain the same FIELD(id, ...) ordering as brands/products
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sibling helpers in BrandRepo/ProductRepo already order by admin-chosen id order with the same idiom; a maintainer adding ordering to page items would copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: category id list used in ORDER BY via the same implode idiom for a category design module
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CategoryRepo already builds raw expressions; category module content carries id lists like products.

O9_family: SQL injection (raw ORDER BY interpolation of id lists, second-order via stored design settings)

O10_build.project_tests: Only Dusk browser tests touching products/brands/design pages (tests/Browser/Pages/Admin/AddProductBrandsTest.php, tests/Data/Admin/DesignPage.php); no unit/feature tests for these repos found

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cast ids to int in DesignService::handleRequestModules (save time) only, leaving repo helpers, settings/values writes and products/names open.

out_of_scope_notes: beike/Repositories/ProductRepo.php:161,164,182 use LIKE with user text via bound where() - parameterised, not pursued.
beike/Console/Commands/GenerateDatabaseDict.php:45 interpolates table name into DB::select - CLI only, not pursued.
beike/Admin/Http/Controllers/DesignController.php:47-63 renders a request-supplied view_path - different weakness, not pursued.
